verification_policy: Direct research with cross-source acquisition verification. Preserve source conflicts and do not infer Ultimate Finish requirements without explicit evidence.
research_scope: Requiem of Destruction — Ki Blast Ultimate.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material identifies Requiem of Destruction as a Ki Blast Ultimate with a grab, explosion, XL-range, 3-hit and knockback characteristics, costing 300 Ki.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Current reference material lists Super Pack 2 and Parallel Quest 106 — A Destructive Showdown as the unlock route.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: Ultimate Finish requirement is recorded as null because the sources establish the PQ unlock route but do not provide sufficient explicit negative or positive Ultimate Finish evidence for the database policy.
verification_audit.variant_policy: Requiem of Destruction is kept distinct from Innocence Cannon and other grab/explosion Ki Blast Ultimates.
verification_audit.damage_policy: The current reference reports three hits and approximately 40% damage, but exact damage is not promoted as a canonical database value because version stability is not established.

records.name: Requiem of Destruction
records.character_source: Vados and Whis customizable partner documented by current references
records.skill_description: Trap an opponent in a powerful Ki Blast before detonating it in a large explosion.
records.mechanics_notes: The user captures the opponent in a large green Ki sphere, temporarily paralyzing them before the sphere detonates. Current reference material classifies it as a grab/explosion Ultimate with XL range, three hits and knockback.
